actions.actionName: Check for Physical Damage and Liquid Exposure
actions.description: It will rule out physical or liquid

steps: Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.

Check the Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI).
Turn off your phone or tablet.

actions.description: It will restore enough battery power

steps: Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger and let it charge for at least 1 hour.

actions.description: It will check whether the device powers

steps: Disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds.
Turn off your device and reconnect it to the appropriate charger until it is fully charged.
Contact the Samsung Support Center for further assistance.

actions.description: It will clear temporary glitches by restarting

steps: If there's no physical or liquid damage, try to force a restart on your device.
Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, remove the battery for 60 seconds, and then reinsert it.
